$comment: Every comparator type a check row may use (spec/check-rows.json comparator.type), with one line of semantics each. tests/build-checks.mjs refuses a row whose comparator is not listed here; the observer (superbuilders/aeo alpha-site-system) publishes the list of comparators it implements and a conformance test reconciles the two (QC loop repair plan 2026-09-25, repair 3). A comparator is a pure judgement of observed against expected with the row's threshold and unit; it never carries a threshold of its own. Add a type here first, then use it in a row.

comparators.equals: observed equals expected after the row's transform (normalize-per-field, campus name, sentence); threshold is the number of differences allowed (0).
comparators.equals-url: observed URL equals expected URL after normalization (https, host lower-cased, trailing slash, no hash or tracking query).
comparators.equals-approved-media: the rendered slot's WordPress attachment id (the wp-image-<id> class or the widget's media id) equals the registry attachmentId for the campus; openMedia video accepts the approved video widget instead; a registry entry with openMedia null, or no entry, is a missingExpectation finding (expected.derive.onMissing finding) carrying literals.missingAsk; a mismatch names the observed asset.
comparators.contains: observed text contains every expected token or pattern; threshold is the minimum number of matches.
comparators.not-contains: observed text contains none of the expected tokens or patterns (sister-brand words, launch words); threshold is the number of hits allowed (0).
comparators.starts-with: observed value starts with one of the expected values (font-family stacks).
comparators.intersects: the observed set and the expected set share at least threshold members (grade ranges, phone forms, tuition figures).
comparators.present: the expected element, record, link or fact is present and visible; threshold is the minimum count.
comparators.absent-after-date: the expected element is absent once the literal's date has passed (seasonal and launch-era CTAs).
comparators.not-placeholder: the observed value is a real destination, never the template placeholder (update link, /..., lorem).
comparators.campus-identity-match: the destination page or record names this campus (registry names or the HubSpot Program name), never another campus.
comparators.only-this-campus: every listed item (event strip cards) belongs to this campus; threshold is the number of foreign items allowed (0).
comparators.in-set: the observed value is one of the expected values (lifecycle states, compatibility pairs).
comparators.host-in-set: the observed URL's host is one of the expected hosts.
comparators.count-equals: the observed count equals the expected count (map pins, duplicate records, missing pages); threshold is the count or the allowed difference as the unit says.
comparators.count-min: the observed count is at least the threshold (sitemap URLs).
comparators.count-max: the observed count is at most the threshold (console errors, clipped elements, offscreen elements).
comparators.max: the observed measurement is at most the threshold in the row's unit (horizontal overflow px).
comparators.distance-max: the observed coordinates are within the threshold distance of the expected ones (metres).
comparators.age-max: the observed timestamp is no older than the threshold (hours) at read time.
comparators.ratio-max: the observed ratio (failed images over visible images) is at most the threshold.
comparators.coverage-min: the observed coverage ratio (visible image height over box, rendered pages over Open campuses) is at least the threshold.
comparators.box-overlap-max: the overlap of two rendered boxes is at most the threshold px or the orThreshold fraction of the smaller box; detectAbove records smaller overlaps as telemetry.
comparators.http-2xx: the destination answers 2xx logged out with no redirect followed.
comparators.http-2xx-after-redirects: the destination answers 2xx logged out after following redirects; threshold is the consecutive runs the row requires as stated on the row.
comparators.http-2xx-rendered: the route answers 2xx and finishes rendering in the browser within the render budget.
comparators.http-status: the observed status (and Location on a redirect) matches the expected status class or redirect target.
comparators.valid-json: the observed document parses as JSON (JSON-LD blocks).
comparators.valid-dates: every expected date field parses as a datetime.
comparators.start-before-end: the observed start datetime is before the end datetime.
comparators.registry-coverage: for each entity the row enumerates (entitySource) and each registry in literals.registries whose requiredWhen matches the entity's lifecycle type, the registry file has an entry at keyPath for the entity's campus slug; each missing entry is one finding (missingExpectation true, the registry named); a registry with an empty requiredWhen.type is informational and never a finding.
